name: surface/human-input
description: Surface human input: keyboards, mice, game pads and game controllers from an input.<engine> engine or an integrated circuit, polled on the IOPool dock.

suggest.jovian/venusian-sdl3: ^0.8.0 - The sdl3 input engine: SDL stages, and gamepads on every OS.
suggest.jovian/venusian-appkit: ^0.8.0 - The appkit input engine: native macOS windows and GameController.framework pads.
suggest.jovian/venusian-gtk: ^0.8.0 - The gtk input engine: native Linux windows and evdev pads.
suggest.dept-of-scrapyard-robotics/wii-connector: ^0.8.0 - Nunchuck, Wii Classic, NES and SNES Classic Mini controllers as input circuits.
suggest.dept-of-scrapyard-robotics/seesaw-mini-g: ^0.8.0 - The Adafruit Mini I2C Gamepad as an input circuit.
suggest.microscrap/scrapyard-evdev: ^0.8.0 - Linux evdev gamepads as input circuits.
